name: story-craft
description: The story before any slide or frame: a guided stock-take of purpose, audience, outputs, evidence and assets (intake.md), a medium-neutral narrative with headline, villain, promise, numbered beats and cuts per output (narrative.md), and a review gate with validator and expert panel. The contract that keynote decks (deck-craft) and launch films (motion-craft) both build from. Adds the stock-take, narrative and story-review skills.
